title: ACKB article
description: One external resource (a link) with its tags. The file name is the article id. Tags are the edges of the knowledge graph: they connect the article to ICs, subcircuits, modules and so on, and through them to related articles.

origin.description: Who published it, when the type doesn't say (e.g. a university lecture video). Sets the confidence.

linkCheck.description: The site blocks automated link checks (e.g. a forum returning 403); checked by hand

summary.description: What this resource covers, in your own words

summaryFromGroup.description: Summary was inherited from a former multi-link topic and should be rewritten for this article

modules.description: Ids from data/taxonomy/modules.json; empty for general topics (history, theory)

components.description: Ids from data/taxonomy/components.json (ICs and special parts such as vactrols)

kinds.description: What the resource is: step-by-step build, how it works, maths/measurements, bare schematics, or reference material (manuals, datasheets, calculators).
